02 / SELECTED WORK

From a question to a working system.

01

ZENO

Voice, context, and everyday work.

Local speech recognition, proactive briefings, and mobile control.

Python · FastAPI · Gemini API

The problem

Work is spread across apps, files, and notifications. Useful context is easy to miss.

The approach

Local speech recognition, contextual briefings, and a bounded observe–act–verify loop.

02

SignSpeak ASL

Turning gestures into understanding.

On-device recognition with hand landmarks and joint-angle kinematics.

JavaScript · MediaPipe · WebAssembly

The problem

Similar hand shapes and moving gestures make real-time ASL recognition challenging.

The approach

Hand landmarks, joint angles, temporal smoothing, and motion tracking in the browser.

ALSO IN MY ORBIT

03

Vigilance

Edge AI / Urban intelligence

Urban road intelligence from transit fleet cameras. Quantized YOLOv8 detects road distress, spatial clustering consolidates repeated sightings, and a WebGIS interface helps organize incidents and repair priorities.

Python · YOLOv8 · ONNX · FastAPI · Next.js

04

FlowPilot

Android / Voice automation

Learn once, replay anywhere. Voice automation for Android, built for the Samsung PRISM GenAI Hackathon 3.0. An exploration of how repeatable mobile workflows can begin with a spoken instruction.

Kotlin · Python · Android · Voice automation
